subject: Re: Kickoff: pre-training vs specialized architectures study
body:
Mid-study status.

Harness and data prep done (Linnea). CGPS reproduction done (Halima) — matches published behavior: strong on the random split, collapses on MCD-style splits. T5 lanes: fine-tuned T5-base already beats CGPS on every MCD split we've run, consistent with the original paper's headline that pre-training closes most of the gap that specialized architectures were built for.

Interesting wrinkle: on our hardest internal split the specialized model wins at small data sizes (<10k examples), crossover around 25k. If that holds it changes the recommendation from "always pre-train" to a data-budget rule.

Risk: the crossover finding needs the full sweep to be trustworthy — 5 seeds x 8 configs x 4 splits. That's the July work Farah is set up to run. Schedule holds.

Gustavo
